notes: Toronto per PitchBook, CB Insights, Dealroom (addresses conflict: First Canadian Place vs 175 Bloor St E), so no address kept. Stage Pre-seed per CB Insights; PitchBook lists 5 employees.

name: Vanhawks
description: Maker of the Valour connected carbon fibre commuter bike.
notes: Acquired by Warren Industries (Concord, ON) in April 2017. Website no longer resolves. YC W2015.

notes: Site lists Toronto, Zurich, Bay Area and Singapore offices without naming an HQ; Toronto per earlier press (Unite.ai, Built In Toronto). Open roles on jobs.ashbyhq.com/veeda-ai. HQ weakly confirmed.
